plate_comment: (Re)initializes the injection hardware: the TPU-A injection channel set (function select / priority / host sequence of channels 2 4 5 7 and 14, interrupt enables) and the injector driver PWMs 16-19 (cm848_loadInjectorDriverCalibration); clears logical output lines 47 / 48, sets the TPU enable and restart flags and counts the restart in fuel_system_hardware_shutdown_error_count_cal (was cm848_tpu_interrupt_flag_init) | earlier note: (Re)initializes the TPU-A channel set used for injection (function select, priority and host-sequence setup of channels 2, 4, 5, 7 and 14, interrupt enables) and the MIOS PWM 16-19 outputs, clears logical output lines 47 / 48, sets tpu_protection_enable_flag and tpu_init_restart_pending_flag, and counts the restart in fuel_system_hardware_shutdown_error_count_cal (cap 255); once the count already exceeds the ROM limit fuel_system_hardware_shutdown_fail_count_threshold (0xffff = never) it sets fault 399 (P0607, control module performance). cm848_protection_timer_init clears the count when its engine-standby check of QADC slots 54 / 55 against fuel_system_hardware_shutdown_error_threshold passes. Name kept: the fault is the retry-limit tail of the initializer.

The fuel system hardware shutdown check (e2m 8041 +28 / +2A FS_HW_Shutdown thresholds, 8C61 +0 error count): gates TPU-A channels 4 and 9 by the engine state and the standby QADC sensors, counts the events and requests the injection hardware restart (was cm848_protection_timer_init)
Resets the aggressive gain logic and the user gain state (0) and copies low_speed_governor_default_gain_set into low_speed_governor_override_gain_set (was cm848_initGovernorLoadStateWrapper)
